targetEntity.securityTip: HTTPS is a baseline trust signal for search and AI. Without it, browsers warn users and ranking risk rises.
targetEntity.serverLocationTip: Server location affects latency and local SEO signals. Hosting closer to your primary audience usually helps.
targetEntity.ttfbTip: TTFB (Time To First Byte) is how long the server takes to send the first byte. Aim for ≤200ms — slower responses raise bounce risk.
targetEntity.indexStatusAllowedHint: Portals like Naver and Google, and AI engines such as ChatGPT and Perplexity, can read and use this page.
targetEntity.indexStatusBlockedHint: Search portals and AI engines are blocked from reading this page, which can limit search and AI answer visibility.
targetEntity.viewportTip: Without a viewport meta tag, mobile layouts can shrink or break. Search and AI engines also weigh mobile friendliness heavily.
